privacy_intro: This page explains what ScoreGuide stores about you, who it is shared with, and how to delete it. ScoreGuide is run from Switzerland and follows the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nFADP) and, for visitors in the EU, the GDPR.
privacy_store_account: Your account: username, email address, and the optional first name, last name and instrument you give us. Your password is only stored as a secure hash; nobody can read it.
privacy_store_library: Your library: the PDFs you upload, the details of each score, your notes and annotations, how often you play each piece, and any table-of-contents corrections you send.
privacy_store_tech: Your IP address, used only to limit abuse (for example too many login attempts). It is not stored with your account.
privacy_where: Everything is stored on Infomaniak servers in Switzerland. The database is backed up daily; backups are encrypted and deleted after 30 days.
privacy_ai: When you use the assistant or ask ScoreGuide to complete a score's details, your question and the details of the relevant scores (title, composer, instrumentation and similar) are sent to the AI provider the site uses: Google (Gemini) or Infomaniak AI Services (Switzerland). Your PDF files are never sent. Completing a score's details also runs a web search (DuckDuckGo) for the piece's title and composer. Please don't type personal information into the assistant.
privacy_email: We only email you to confirm your address and to reset your password. No newsletters, no marketing.
privacy_cookies: ScoreGuide uses a login cookie and a language cookie, and stores your light/dark theme in your browser. There are no ads, no analytics and no tracking, and fonts are served from our own server.
privacy_share: Your data is never sold. It is only shared with the providers named above, to run the service, or when required by law.
privacy_rights: You can see and correct your details on your account page. Deleting your account there removes your account, scores, notes and PDFs immediately; copies in backups disappear within 30 days. To get a copy of your data or ask anything about it, use the contact page.
